mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or 60-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) and robust supply (INDPRO) simultaneously indicate a strong economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase by >5% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO increasing by >5% in the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 7.5% signals labor market stress, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when UNRATE rises >0.1pp in 1 month, or returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO crossing above 100 signals robust production growth, stimulating consumer demand and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite INDPRO crossing above 100.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST crossing above 1100 indicates strong housing demand, boosting construction and related sectors, which positively impacts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite HOUST crossing above 1100.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing risk premiums and enhancing equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS <1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong demand (GDPC1) and labor market growth (PAYEMS) above thresholds suggest robust economic activity, increasing corporate profits and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and PAYEMS increase by >10% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite both GDPC1 and PAYEMS increasing by >10% in the prior 3 months.
